recent.text: And Miami escapes with a 108-105 win. Heat ran the exact same play as they did when they needed to inbound the first time. Pelle Larsson got it back this time from Davion Mitchell for a dunk. Jalen Brunson tried to draw a foul on the drive back down. But missed the game-tying 3
